verdict.rationale: The docs give a short install path: run `$skill-installer linear` or `/plugins`, start a new session, then invoke the skill with `$` or `/skills`. A hands-on probe installed the plugin-creator skill keylessly into a scratch directory with a single `npx skills add` command and produced a valid SKILL.md. Missing for 10: a dedicated end-to-end skills quickstart page (the only quickstart shown is for MCP apps), any timing evidence supporting the under-five-minutes claim, and independent reports of the onboarding experience.
